title: Assessment of the Acceptability of, and Factors Associated With, Recommended Vaccinations During Pregnancy in Maternity Units in the Ile-de-France Region
official: Assessment of the Acceptability of, and Factors Associated With, Recommended Vaccinations During Pregnancy in Maternity Units in the Ile-de-France Region
summary: The objective of this study is to assess vaccination coverage (VC) for vaccines recommended during pregnancy (pertussis, COVID-19, seasonal influenza, and respiratory syncytial virus \[RSV\] infection), their acceptability, and the factors associated with this acceptability among pregnant women and healthcare professionals in several maternity units in the Île-de-France region. We plan to estimate vaccination coverage using health-related (type of follow-up) and relevant socio-educational strata at the regional level in Île-de-France. An overall estimate of vaccination coverage for the Île-de-France region will be obtained by weighting according to regional data for these strata. Estimates of vaccination coverage according to determinants-particularly socio-educational factors-will allow extrapolation to other French regions, in order to better define strategies for promoting vaccination among pregnant women and the healthcare professionals who care for them. The wide diversity of maternity unit profiles in Île-de-France, together with the substantial socio-educational diversity of the regional population, will enable a nuanced and comprehensive overview.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria :

1. Postpartum women:

   * Women aged 18 years and older.
   * Women in the immediate postpartum period (during the maternity stay) having given birth to one or more live-born infants.
   * Women who delivered after 36 weeks of gestation.
2. Healthcare professionals :

   * Vaccinating healthcare professionals (physicians, midwives, or nurses) providing pregnancy care and working in a maternity unit participating in the study.

Exclusion Criteria :

\- Postpartum women :

* Individuals under legal protection (guardianship, curatorship, or trusteeship).
* Women who delivered after fetal death or following a medical termination of pregnancy.
